title: The Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary:
These Regulations amend the 
Registration of Births and Deaths Regulations 1987 (S.I. 1987/2088) (“the 1987 Regulations”) and the 
Registration of Births and Deaths (Welsh Language) Regulations 1987 (S.I. 1987/2089) (“the Welsh Language Regulations”).

title: The Renewables Obligation and Electricity Capacity (Amendment) (British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme Excluded Electricity) Regulations 2026
The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Hampstead) Regulations 2026
The Registration of Births and Deaths (England and Wales) (Specified Requirements) Regulations 2026
summary: Under the Births and Deaths Registration Act 1953, certain people are required to attend the register office to give information about a birth, death or still-birth, and physically sign the register. Section 38B of that Act allows the Minister to specify requirements and to provide that the duty to sign the register has effect as a duty to comply with those specified requirements. If the requirements are complied with, the person will be taken to have signed the register and, where relevant, do have done so in the presence of the registrar.

title: The Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (Commencement No. 10) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force sections 61 to 65 of the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (c. 18) (“the 2025 Act”). Regulation 2(1) brings the provisions specified in that regulation into force on 9th November 2026. Regulation 2(2) brings section 61(3) of the 2025 Act into force at 12.01 am on that date. These are the 10th commencement regulations made under the 2025 Act.

title: The Cumberland (Electoral Changes) Order 2026
summary: This Order makes changes to electoral arrangements for the district of Cumberland following recommendations made by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England. This Order does not change the boundary of the district itself.

title: The Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Act 2026 (Commencement No. 1) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the fourth set of commencement regulations bringing into force provisions of the Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Act 2026 (c. 21) (“the Act”). They are the first set of regulations commencing provisions of the Act which substantively relate to a territory other than England, namely section 10 which relates to social care in England and Wales.

title: The Strategic Planning (Consequential and Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations revoke and amend secondary legislation relating to strategic planning.

title: The Strategic Planning (Costs of Public Examinations) (Standard Daily Amount) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations, which apply in relation to England only, apply where the Secretary of State is authorised to recover costs arising in connection with a public examination under section 12I or 12P(6)(a) of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (c. 5).

title: The Strategic Planning Authorities (Spatial Development Strategy) Regulations 2026
summary: Part 1A of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (c. 5) (inserted by section 58 of the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (c. 34)) requires strategic planning authorities to prepare a spatial development strategy (“SDS”) for their area. These Regulations make provision as to the procedure to be followed in connection with the preparation of a SDS.

title: The Spatial Development Strategy (Examination Procedure) Rules 2026
summary: Part 1A of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (c. 5) (inserted by section 58 of the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (c. 34)) requires strategic planning authorities to prepare a spatial development strategy. Unless the Secretary of State directs otherwise, a draft spatial development strategy must be subject to an examination.

title: The Seafarers (Wages and Working Conditions) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made under the Seafarers (Wages and Working Conditions) Act 2023 (c. 8) (“the Act”).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Birmingham Christmas Market) Regulations 2026
The Crime and Policing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force specified provisions of the Crime and Policing Act 2026 (c. 20) (“the 2026 Act”). These are the fifth commencement regulations made under the 2026 Act.

title: The Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (Commencement No. 5) and English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the fifth commencement regulations made under the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (c. 34) (“the 2025 Act”) and the fifth commencement regulations made under the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (c. 23) (“the 2026 Act”). These Regulations bring into force provisions relating to spatial development strategies.

title: The International Controlled Transaction Reporting Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision in connection with the provision of information in relation to international controlled transactions.

title: The Customs (Tariff and Miscellaneous Amendments) (No. 7) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulation 2 amends the definition of “the authorised use document” in regulation 32(2) of the Customs (Special Procedures and Outward Processing) (EU Exit) Regulations 2018 (S.I. 2018/1249) to refer to a new version of that document. The new version of that document introduces authorised use measures to reduce the rate of import duty on nine commodity codes relating to steel goods used in the manufacture of bright bar, a precision-finished steel bar product, and wire. Further, it introduces authorised use measures to reduce the rate of import duty on six commodity codes relating to steel goods for the manufacture of linepipe, a steel pipe used in the construction of pipelines to transport oil, gas and other fluids.

title: The Financial Services (Gibraltar) (Amendment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations extend by 12 months the transitional arrangements under Parts 2 and 3 of the Financial Services (Gibraltar) (Amendment) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (S.I. 2019/589) which enable specified categories of Gibraltar-based firms to provide financial services in the United Kingdom and facilitate the access by similar types of UK-based firms to Gibraltar’s financial services market.

title: The Control of Asbestos (Amendment etc.) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 (S.I. 2012/632) (“the 2012 Regulations”) to introduce a requirement that the assessment of the cleanliness of the premises, where work relating to asbestos has been carried out, is undertaken by a person who is appointed independently of the person who carried out the work relating to asbestos on those premises.

title: The Data-gathering (Ongoing Data: Interest and Payment Card Transactions) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision requiring persons of specified description to provide specified data to His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs (“HMRC”) on an ongoing basis.
